Subject: Recap & next steps — Riverbend trial refocus: intent classification + reranking

Alex — thanks for the productive call earlier. Quick written recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we finalize the MAP. High level: Riverbend wants to prioritize two POC use cases for the coming trial window: 1) intent classification + routing for chat/agent handoff, 2) batch reranking for product search.

What we discussed (TL;DR):
- Scope: intent classification (low-latency inference path) + batch reranking (throughput path for nightly re-ranks).
- Success criteria (initial proposal):
  * Intent: intent accuracy >= 88% on Riverbend labeled dev set; routing correctness >= 90% for top-priority intents.
  * Reranking: mean reciprocal rank (MRR) improvement >= +0.06 over baseline; top-1 click lift >= +4%.
  * Performance: Latency P95 for intent path < 180ms in your region; batch rerank throughput >= 1000 docs/min on dedicated instance.
- Evaluation: 2 sample datasets from Riverbend (chat intents: ~5k examples; search logs: 50k queries for rerank evaluation). We'll run 3-week evaluation after model calibration.
- Timeline (proposed):
  * Data handoff & account setup: week of Sep 7
  * Pilot calibration week: Sep 14–20
  * Evaluation window: Sep 21–Oct 9 (3 weeks)
- Owners: Monica (Redwood technical lead / infra & ingest), Marissa (Redwood success / program manager), Alex (Riverbend PM).

Open items for Riverbend to confirm:
1) Provide S3 path or short-term credentials for dataset ingest (sample + full eval slices).
2) Procurement: do you need an MSA or PO before we start? (Alex, you mentioned procurement involvement).
3) Cost expectations / budget cap (e.g., target $X per 1M tokens or blended pilot cap) — helps us recommend quantization/profile.

Attachments: RB-MAP-draft-2026-08-29.xlsx (MAP skeleton), sample-ingest-schema.json (what we need for tokenization).

Next steps I propose:
- Alex: confirm dataset access and procurement trigger by EOD Tue Aug 31.
- Monica: I asked health-check of data format and an ingest ETA.
- Marissa: I asked to book a kickoff for Sep 8 and prepare the evaluation matrix.

If any of the acceptance thresholds above look off, call them out and we can rebaseline before ingestion — better to get the guardrails now than mid-run.

Thanks — Karthik

--

Karthik — thanks for the crisp recap. We’re aligned on the two prioritized workflows. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Datasets: we can provide the 5k intents CSV and the 50k search log sample. I’ll share an S3 bucket link by EOD today. Note that our search logs contain noisy clicks (~15% noise) — will that affect rerank thresholds?
2) Procurement: procurement@riverbend.ai will require a short SOW + estimated spend cap for the pilot. They typically ask for a PO if spend exceeds $25k in the pilot window.
3) Cost cap: we need a rough expected cost to compare against internal budget. Can Redwood provide an estimated token/compute cost and a suggested quantization profile that balances latency vs cost?
4) Data retention: we need confirmation on retention window and whether any raw customer PII will be uploaded — we will scrub PII but want confirmation on Redwood's retention controls.

We’ll push the S3 link and an internal note to procurement. Once we have a SOW and MAP I can route to procurement for a PO if needed.

Alex Chen

Forwarding Alex below and adding technical notes / risks we should call out to Riverbend before ingestion.

----- Forwarded message from Alex Chen <alex.chen@riverbend.ai> -----
> Karthik — thanks for the crisp recap...

Monica (technical summary):
- Ingest: we can support S3 ingest + pre-tokenization step. Ask: Riverbend please provide example Parquet/CSV layout; sample-ingest-schema.json helps but I’d like a small sample file.
- Reranking evaluation: because labels are noisy, I recommend we relax top-1 click lift threshold to +3% for initial run and then re-evaluate with manual review of 2k examples. MRR target stays as-is but we’ll capture confidence intervals.
- Latency: intent path P95 < 200ms is achievable on our optimized path with a 16-bit quantized model and KV cache enabled for common prefixes; note that warm-up/first-token will be higher.
- Cost: suggest two quantization profiles in MAP: q4_0 (lower latency, higher cost) and q3_k (lower cost, slightly higher latency). We’ll include estimated $/1M token ranges for each.

Action items for internal team:
1) Build eval_matrix-v1.csv (metrics, slices, sample sizes) — I’ll draft this today.
2) Prepare a short SOW template with estimated spend caps for procurement.
3) Confirm retention and PII policy for Riverbend (Marissa to confirm legal/compliance wording).

Attachments: eval_matrix-v1.csv (draft).
